subject: Draft MAP & pricing contingency — AptEdge discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Nair <priya@aptedge.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2027 14:02:00 +0000
Subject: Draft MAP & pricing contingency — AptEdge discovery follow-up

Hi Priya (and Amit),

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — good conversation and helpful clarity on the three integration milestones you care about. Per our call, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP_AptEdge_v1.xlsx) with suggested milestone owners and dates. High-level summary below and requested confirmation items.

Quick recap / proposed MAP highlights:
- Milestone 1 (PoC integration): Redwood to deliver sample connector + baseline perf tests — Owner: Redwood (SRE lead) — Target: 2027-06-03
- Milestone 2 (Security & compliance review): Provide SOC 2 artifacts + architecture review — Owner: AptEdge (security) + Redwood (security eng) — Target: 2027-06-10
- Milestone 3 (Pilot SLA & scale test): 72-hour pilot at target QPS with monitoring handoff — Owner: AptEdge product + Redwood operations — Target: 2027-06-21
- Target commercial close: 2027-06-30 (aligns with your procurement cycle)

Open items / asks for AptEdge:
1) Confirm milestone owners and the SOC contact who will receive our artifacts (we referenced security@aptedge.ai earlier)
2) Confirm target commit level for pricing (we discussed a 12-month commitment vs a 6-month pilot-only option)
3) Procurement ask: you mentioned requesting credits for go-live — please indicate a target credit level so we can route for internal approval

Internal note: attaching pricing_summary.xlsx for Ben/Marissa — this MAP will need a pricing/credit decision from leadership before I share the final version with AptEdge.

Attachments:
- MAP_AptEdge_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)
- pricing_summary.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)

Next steps:
- Priya: confirm SOC contact and commit preference by EOD Wednesday (2027-05-13)
- Ben/Marissa: can you weigh in on the credit ask below so I can be explicit in the MAP?

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: MAP_AptEdge_v1.xlsx]

From: Priya Nair <priya@aptedge.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@aptedge.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2027 18:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & pricing contingency — AptEdge discovery follow-up

Sofia — thanks for the quick recap and the draft MAP. Helpful.

A few clarifications from our side:
- SOC contact is me (priya@aptedge.ai); I will coordinate with our procurement and security teams.
- For pilot vs commit: our preferred path is a 6-week pilot (to validate latency/throughput and integration) followed by a 12-month committed agreement if the pilot meets SLAs.
- Regarding credits: procurement typically asks for a credit equivalent to the first 30 days of run-costs as a go-live buffer. Can Redwood confirm whether that is feasible or if you need a specific commit level to approve credits?
- Timeline: we can target the Pilot start in early June, SOC artifacts by Friday (2027-05-14) would be ideal so our security review can start.

Also attaching a short list of compliance questions (SOC2 checklist) that our security team will use.

Thanks,
Priya Nair
CTO, AptEdge
priya@aptedge.ai
[Attachment: SOC2_question_list.pdf]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2027 19:45:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Draft MAP & pricing contingency — AptEdge discovery follow-up

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Priya's reply. Main asks: credit ~30 days of run-costs, pilot then 12-month commit. Priya can get SOC artifacts by Friday.

Ben: can you confirm what commit bands unlock a one-month credit and whether we can offer a conditional credit (credit applied after signed contract + invoice) vs. upfront?
Marissa: FYI — this will likely need a pricing/leader approval. If we can align on a conditional credit option, I’ll update MAP and re-share.

Quick note for the MAP update: we should put the target close date as 2027-06-30 and make the credit conditional on a 12-month commitment or on hitting a usage threshold in the first 30 days.

Thanks,
Sofia

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 13 May 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft MAP & pricing contingency — AptEdge discovery follow-up

Sofia / Ben — reviewed. Approve the conditional credit with these constraints:

- Offer: One month of credits (applied as a post-signing invoice credit) up to $25k, contingent on a signed 12-month commitment at the agreed T&Cs OR a documented usage milestone (>= 1.5x baseline QPS) completed within 30 days of go-live.
- Finance action: I’ve asked finance to prepare a credit memo template and include the credit cap. Ben, please add the commit language to the commercial terms in pricing_summary.xlsx and mark the deal record in HubSpot.
- Security: provide SOC 2 artifacts by Friday; we will label them as "shared under NDA" in our internal workflow.

Related links: HubSpot deal RDW-DEAL-98765 for AptEdge, DocuSign draft shared (PowerForm link).

I will sign-off once the MAP includes the conditional credit wording and commit clause.

— Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: pricing_summary.xlsx]

From: Priya Nair <priya@aptedge.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@aptedge.ai>, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 13 May 2027 12:00:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & pricing contingency — AptEdge discovery follow-up

Sofia / Marissa / Ben — thanks, that works for us.

We accept the conditional credit structure (one-month credit up to $25k applied after signing) with the 12-month commit OR the usage milestone approach. We’ll aim for the pilot start week of 2027-06-07 and target close 2027-06-30.

I will share SOC 2 artifacts by EOD Friday (2027-05-14) to priya@aptedge.ai and copy procurement for the DocuSign flow. Please send an updated MAP and a DocuSign link when ready.

Regards,
Priya Nair
CTO, AptEdge
[Attachment: SOC2_evidence_request.pdf]
